ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: THE INTERNATIONAL PROGRAM AT CEPR CONDUCTS RIGOROUS RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS TO MAKE SIGNIFICANT CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE U.S. AND INTERNATIONAL POLICY DEBATES ON KEY GLOBAL ISSUES. WE PRODUCE REPORTS/ARTICLES CONDUCT PANEL DISCUSSIONS AND ENGAGE WITH PARTNERS, POLICYMAKERS, MEDIA, AND THE PUBLIC, PLAYING A KEY ROLE IN INFORMING THESE AUDIENCES. WE MONITOR THE IMFS POLICIES AND ACTIONS FOR THOSE THAT ARE HARMFUL TO COUNTRIES, AS WELL AS THOSE THAT CAN BE BENEFICIAL. BUILDING ON OUR PRIOR EFFORTS THAT WERE KEY TO WINNING THE 2021 ISSUANCE OF 650BN OF IMF SPECIAL DRAWING RIGHTS, WHICH SAVED HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS OF LIVES, WE CONTINUE MAKING THE CASE FOR NEW SDR ALLOCATIONS. WE ANALYZE ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL DEVELOPMENTS IN LATIN AMERICA, DRAWING ATTENTION TO THE IMPACT OF US POLICY. WE PLAY A KEY ROLE IN INFORMING POLICYMAKERS AND THE PUBLIC ON THE HARMFUL AND LETHAL IMPACT OF U.S. ECONOMIC SANCTIONS WHICH OFTEN TARGET THE GENERAL POPULATION. WE PRODUCE ANALYSIS THAT PROMOTES A MORE SUSTAINABLE, EQUITABLE, AND ACCOUNTABLE SYSTEM OF FINANCE, COMMERCE, AND TRADE.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: 1 ATTRACTION OF PUBLIC SUPPORT CEPR HAS AN ONGOING PROGRAM OF GENERATING SUPPORT FROM THE PUBLIC, FOUNDATIONS AND OTHER PUBLIC CHARITIES. CEPRS DEVELOPMENT STAFF ACTIVELY SOLICITS GRANTS AND WORKS TO EXPAND THE FUNDRAISING BASE TO SUPPORT THE ORGANIZATIONS MISSION WHICH IS TO PROMOTE DEMOCRATIC DEBATE ON ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL ISSUES THROUGH PUBLIC DEBATE AND EDUCATION.
2 PERCENTAGE OF PUBLIC SUPPORT THE PERCENTAGE OF PUBLIC SUPPORT IS CLOSER TO 33 1/3 THAN 10 AND CEPR IS WORKING TO INCREASE THE PERCENTAGE

3 SOURCES OF SUPPORT SINCE ITS INCEPTION IN 1999, CEPR HAS RECEIVED SUPPORT FROM A REPRESENTATIVE OF DONORS, INCLUDING MANY FOUNDATIONS AND PUBLIC CHARITIES THAT PROVIDE ASSISTANCE TO ECONOMIC RESEARCH THAT IS CRUCIAL FOR LIFTING PEOPLE OUT OF POVERTY. CEPR IS ACCOUNTABLE TO DONORS AND PROVIDES FINAL GRANT REPORTS THAT DOCUMENTS PROGRAM AND BUDGET ACTIVITY.

4 REPRESENTATIVE GOVERNING BODY CEPRS BOARD OF DIRECTORS IS COMPOSED OF INDIVIDUALS DRAWN FROM A VARIETY OF FIELDS THAT ARE DIRECTLY RELEVANT TO THE ORGANIZATIONS MISSION. THESE INDIVIDUALS INCLUDE LEADING ECONOMISTS, ACADEMICS, ACTIVISTS, AND NONPROFIT LEADERS. NONE OF THE BOARD MEMBERS ARE RELATED BY FAMILY CONNECTIONS.

5 PUBLIC BENEFIT CEPR OFFERS RESEARCH AND TOOLS TO THE GENERAL PUBLIC AS WELL AS STATE, LOCAL AND FEDERAL DECISIONMAKERS TO HELP THEM CREATE INFORMED POLICIES AND ADDRESS SOCIETYS ECONOMIC NEEDS AND PROBLEMS. CEPR DISSEMINATES INFORMATION TO THE PUBLIC THROUGH PUBLICATIONS, SOCIAL MEDIA, SYMPOSIUMS AND VARIOUS EDUCATIONAL EVENTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CENTER IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 501C3. IN ADDITION, THE ORGANIZATION HAS BEEN CLASSIFIED AS AN ORGANIZATION THAT IS NOT A PRIVATE ORGANIZATION UNDER SECTION 509A1. THE FEDERAL FORM 990, RETURN OF ORGANIZATION EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAX, IS SUBJECT TO EXAMINATION BY THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE, GENERALLY FOR THREE YEARS AFTER IT IS FILED.

THE DIRECTORS MONITOR, REVIEW, AND APPROVE ALL GRANTS PAID TO THE ORGANIZATION. GRANTEES ARE REQUIRED TO SUBMIT A GRANT REPORT AT THE END OF THE GRANT TERM DESCRIBING HOW THE FUNDS WERE USED, WHAT WAS ACCOMPLISHED WITH THE GRANT FUNDS, AND CONFIRMATION THAT THE ORGANIZATION ABIDED BY THE TERMS OF THE GRANT AGREEMENT.
